description: Schedule Lab engine derived from definitive regular-season weekly history. Includes no-self-match schedule substitution, every owner-on-schedule replay, schedule equity, career SOS totals, presentation badges, historical findings, and a vetted Random What-If pool.

definitions.expectedWins: Sum of weekly all-play win probabilities based on the owner's own score. Ties count as half a win.
definitions.scheduleExpectedWins: Expected wins for a random league team facing the owner's exact opponent scores.
definitions.scheduleDifficultyWins: League-average schedule expected wins minus the owner's schedule expected wins. Positive is tougher.
definitions.scheduleDifficultyIndex: 100 × league-average schedule expected wins ÷ owner's schedule expected wins. Above 100 is tougher.
definitions.replayMatrix: Rows are scoring owners; columns are schedule owners. When the copied schedule originally faced the scoring owner, the schedule owner is substituted as the opponent to avoid a team playing itself.
definitions.scheduleEquity: Average/best/worst replayed wins across all 10 schedules plus the best-to-worst range.
definitions.ties: Only genuine equal-score comparisons count as ties; self-match ties are eliminated by substitution.

scheduleBadgeThresholds.note: Thresholds are display labels only; the underlying SOS Index remains continuous.
